name: Sister Prison
source:
Hidemi lost his parents to an accident, and starts to live with his sisters, Mari and Asako. 
On his birthday, he receives a present from them.
It was his statement for school withdrawal and his sisters' confession of love who have gone mad.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE048599.html]English DLsite[/url]]
